text:
Alex: Heads up — noticed a spike where several users in prod temporarily had org-admin for ~12m during SCIM sync window yesterday.
Alex: Repro steps: saw group removal + role-binding cleanup interleaving.
Alex: Logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-19T22:14:12Z SCIM: ADD membership user:u123 -> group:infra-admins (extId g-ops)
2026-03-19T22:14:45Z Auth: issued token for u123 claims: roles=[org-admin]
2026-03-19T22:25:01Z SCIM: REMOVE membership user:u123 -> group:infra-admins
2026-03-19T22:26:00Z RoleReconcile: failed to remove roleBinding rb-u123-admin (timeout)
``` 
Meera: Are these true elevations or cached claims in the console?
Alex: Token introspect shows admin claim present for ~11m; audit shows roleBinding creation but missing final deletion event — reconcile job retried and eventually cleaned up after ~12m.
security-bot: Alert: privilege-drift-detect — 8 admin roleBindings created during window for customers-prod org.
Chris: Sounds like a race in provisioner -> role-binding cleanup path. We recently changed group-id hashing in PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2345, could be related.
Sam: Running a dry-run reconcile now: `./bin/scim-reconcile --dry-run --env=prod`
Sam: dry-run output: 7 stale roleBindings that should be removed (list attached)
Sam: running actual reconcile: `./bin/scim-reconcile --apply --filter=org-admin`
Meera: Alex — can you list affected user ids and whether any KMS policy changes occurred? If KMS keys were touched escalate immediately.
Alex: Uploaded CSV to drive: https://drive.redwood/incident/2012345678/affected_users.csv
Alex: No PutKeyPolicy calls in cloudtrail for those users, only standard read ops.
Chris: Good. Still need to harden: 1) make scim provisioner idempotent on rename/remove, 2) add transactional role-binding deletion, 3) alert on admin-binding delta > 3 in 5m.
Sam: I disabled scheduled SCIM job for 30m and will keep manual reconciles until patch is live.
Alex: Hotfix branch created and pushed: https://github.com/redwood/repo/compare/fix/scim-idempotency (PR 201)
security-bot: Incident recorded: id 2026-03-19-privilege-drift-2012345678
Meera: Bumping to Sev-2 until we validate no customer impact. Also assign postmortem owner: @Chris
Chris: Will write a 24h postmortem draft. Include runbook updates and KMS least-privilege checklist.
Alex: Follow-up actions: add audit hook to emit roleBinding deletions to audit log, unit test for rename path, and add one-off monitor for token claim TTL mismatches.
Meera: Thanks everyone. Please add follow-ups to the incident doc and tag me when postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:
